definition: xaitment is a German-based company that develops and sells artificial intelligence (AI) software to video game developers and simulation developers.
details: The company was founded in 2004 by Dr. Andreas Gerber, and is a spin-off of the German Research Centre for Artificial Intelligence, or DFKI. xaitment has its main office in Quierschied, Germany, and field offices in San Francisco and China.

explainer.lead: xaitment is a German company that develops and sells AI software to video game and simulation developers. Founded in 2004 by Dr. Andreas Gerber, it is a spin-off of the German Research Centre for Artificial Intelligence (DFKI).

tiers.eli5: It's a German company that makes the AI brains for video games and simulations.
tiers.practitioner: Game and simulation developers license its AI software rather than building behavior systems in-house. Its roots in DFKI research shape its positioning in the games tooling market.
